lines: THE SHRINE OF BADB, LILYFEN, LEAFWOOD
Kaldor stands when she sees you. ‘You’re back. Tell me.’
You show Kaldor what you copied at the old dead under the old woods.

Kaldor turns the pages slowly, and is a long time saying anything. ‘So that is who they were,’ Kaldor says at last. ‘The brothers will want this.’ Coin is pressed into your hand for the road: the order pays its debts, even through other people’s purses.
The shrine-keeper reads your copy again at the door. ‘The makers kept day in a jar,’ she says. ‘Against what sleeps below.’
Edwy and Gareth each gain 300 experience.
